01-builtin-trs-declaration.description: Made by `tro-utils` with no TRS declaration given, so it uses the minimal TRS declaration built into `tro-utils`, which has no capabilities and no public key. Describes one performance: an analysis of a data file; and two arrangements. Claims no attributes.

02-readme-trs-declaration.description: Made by `tro-utils` with `readme-trs-declaration.jsonld` representing a TRS that can record internet access and provide internet isolation. Describes two performances: a download of a data file and an analysis of it; and three arrangements. The download claims its internet access was recorded; the analysis claims it was isolated from the internet.

03-readme-trs-declaration-signed.description: Made by `tro-utils` with `readme-trs-declaration.jsonld` representing a TRS that can record internet access and provide internet isolation and is accompanied by a signing key pair, `trs-key.asc`, whose public key the TRS carries. Signed with that key pair. Describes three performances: a download of a data file, an analysis of it, and a packaging of the scripts and results; and four arrangements. The download claims its internet access was recorded; the analysis and the packaging claim they were isolated from the internet.
